Epic Wings II

Please visit

STORYLINE/PLOT
Spoiler
Follow the adventure of Legere. A broken man who lost the most important thing in life must now save the world from the fallen and in order to do so he must first collect all seven of the dragon ba- errr... I mean, he must first defeat all the evil doers in his path!
Unlockable characters, if that's what floats your boat?
An RPG with a taste of a good story! I think? I hope so... I mean, 2 years of development, we hope it's good right!? RIGHT!? Each playable character has a small back story for players to really understand the people their playing as.
SYNOPSIS
Spoiler
A jrpg/turn-styled +13 hour game with +5 hours of optional content.... Optional? Opti..... wait.... the whole game is optional but we hope to bring you the best entertainment!

posts.author: RPGMaker23
posts.body:
It's game complete?
Can I play it from begin to end?
Where it's save folder?

posts.author: thenerdmansion
posts.body:
Hello! Firstly, thank you for your interest in Epic Wings 2
!! To answer your question, the game is complete and can be played from start to finish. From beginning to end. The save folder can be found in C:\users\(your username)\AppData\Local\epicwings2 you will have to enable hidden files in your settings to see it. Only your save files are stored here
.

posts.author: thenerdmansion
posts.body:
Hello all, huge updates to this game have been made. The game has been completely remastered. Thank you all for your time and much love
.
-a lot of grammar corrections.
-dialogue changes.
-added back to title screen option in main menu(Was not working in previous versions).
-revive skill fixed and can be used outside of battle now.
-tank skill works as it was intended by the dev now.
-fixed eater barrage skill being broken and healing to much.
-first major boss has greater HP now (was too wasy and disappointing).
-changed the name of water jug to antique vase (makes more sense to the story).
-fixed Nova City cave can send you into the past. Created new map for present cave.
-fixed third relic boss broken immortality moveset and immortality turns.
-fixed portal scrolls not working sometimes.
-fixed bug where Hector not doing enough damage when magical concentration activated.
-fixed battleback not enabled in some maps.
-fixed portal scrolls getting consumed when player uses them during events where game does not allow portal scroll usage.
-Corrected many weapon descrpition misspellings.
-fixed Butchers Knight/Burchers Knight +2 was unsellable. Added a sell and purchase price.
-Reworked walk path of some NPC's who would block the players path.
-Corrected pricing of some shop choices. in the Vehicle/City Passes map.
-Rebuilt battlebacks to look 3D.
-Adjusted tournament price for prizes.
-Fixed a glitch where Lucia's Savage Barrage skill became weaker after the level 30 ascension transformation.
-Updated Glorious Dusting skill description to describe the skill more accurately.
-Fixed a glitch that made many of the samurai skills overpowered.
-Fixed a shop that wasn't selling all the items that it was supposed to sell.
-Changed final battle Dot damage from 200 to 350 per turn.

It is an older game so it was created in MV and the plugin is AltMenuScreen although stripped of many of its rtp components like the RM window which can be found in the the pic/systems folder and using a custom images for all the windows in the menu created in gimp. As far as the menu facesets for the main screen I took the battler sprites from each character and used the animation that I liked the most from each and put it into a single enlarged faceset image so it’s not actually pulling any data from the characters to get the sprite. Just enlarged images created by me in gimp
. I hope this helps answer some questions and happy deving!
